Goal
Be the last hamster standing.

Your turn
Play any action cards you like, then end your turn by drawing one card from the deck.

Doom
Draw a Doom card and you lose a life. A Snack Stash saves you. Lose all your lives and you\'re out.

Cheating – the Snack Stash bluff
When you face a Doom you can play a real Snack Stash, or bluff by claiming one you don\'t have. The other players then vote Accept or Challenge:
• Nobody challenges – your claim stands and you survive.
• Challenged while bluffing – you\'re caught and take the Doom.
• Challenged but you really had it – the challenger was wrong and pays for it.

Cards
• Snack Stash – Saves you from one Doom.
• Sign of Fate – Gain 1 life.
• Power Nap – Skip drawing and end your turn.
• Quick Peek – Privately see the top card.
• Sniff Ahead – Secretly see the top 3 cards.
• Tunnel Chaos – Shuffle the deck.
• Tiny Thief – Steal a random card from a player.
• Beg for Snacks – Name a card and a player; if they have it, they hand it over.
• Cage Swap – Swap hands with the next player.
• Hyper Mode – The next player takes an extra turn.
• Squick – Cancel the last played card.
• Hamster Combos – Play 2 to steal a random card, 3 to take a named card, 4 to steal a life.
